username.title: Username / Email
username.description: Same username/email used in the Toshiba Home AC Control app.

password.title: Password
password.description: Same password used in the Toshiba Home AC Control app.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: State Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Fallback cloud polling interval. Real-time AMQP push updates are still used.

discoveryRefreshMinutes.title: Discovery Refresh (minutes)
discoveryRefreshMinutes.description: How often to re-scan Toshiba cloud account for added/removed devices.

requestTimeoutSeconds.title: HTTP Timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for Toshiba cloud API requests (official app behavior is 60s).

httpRetries.title: HTTP Retries
httpRetries.description: Number of retries for transient cloud API failures (official app behavior is 5 retries).

enableFanService.title: Expose Fan Service (Deprecated)
enableFanService.description: Deprecated and ignored. Plugin now exposes a single HeaterCooler service only.

enableFeatureSwitches.title: Expose Feature Switches (Deprecated)
enableFeatureSwitches.description: Deprecated and ignored. Plugin now exposes a single HeaterCooler service only.

enableTemperatureSensors.title: Expose Temperature Sensors (Deprecated)
enableTemperatureSensors.description: Deprecated and ignored. Plugin now exposes a single HeaterCooler service only.
